violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Written Procedures
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not prepared and stored according to written procedures: OBSERVED PARTIALLY COOKED GRILLED CHICKEN ON A STOVE-TOP COOLING DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be prepared and stored according to written procedures that have obtained approval from the regulatory authority, are maintained in the food establishment and are available to the regulatory authority upon request, describe hot the requirements are to be monitored and documented and corrective actions taken, describe how the foods are to be marked as foods that must be further cooked, describe how the foods are to be separated from ready-to-eat foods. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT THE ESTABLISHMENT SHOULD NOT BE NON-CONTINUOUSLY COOKING ANY RAW ANIMAL PROTEINS WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL. EHS REVIEWED REQUIREMENTS FOR NON-CONTINUOUS COOKING PROCESS WITH THE PIC. ESTABLISHMENT HAS AGREED TO DISCONTINUE PROCESS AND WILL CONTACT THE EHS IN THE FUTURE IF THEY WISH TO SUBMIT WRITTEN PROCEDURES IN THE FUTURE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE SMALL GLASS DISHWASHING MACHINE MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 132F.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. ESTABLISHMENT WILL CONTACT A REPAIR TECHNICIAN AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND WILL DISCONTINUE USING DISHWASHING MACHINE UNTIL IT CAN MEET 160F AT A MINMUM.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the bar handsink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO PUT PAPER TOWELS AT THIS HANDSINK.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: 1) Spanish tortilla was observed at 63f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CHEF INSTRUCTED STAFF TO DISCARD THE SPANISH TORTILLAS THAT WERE COOLING ON THE SPEED RACK OUTSIDE OF THE WALK-IN.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR low boy cooler (named mini sauté); vegetable stock was observed at 45f; chicken stock was observed at 43f; lobster stock was observed at 43f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CHEF INSTRUCTED STAFF TO DISCARD THE STOCK. BARCELONA (Inspection Date: 12/09/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: EHS observed tuna tartar, foie gras, salmon and duck eggs without a consumer advisory
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PIC remade menus for EHS to verify compliance. PIC disposed of old menus without consumer advisory.

out_items.name: Food additives; approved and properly used

violations.title: Approved Additives
violations.observation: Food offered for service or sale contains the following unapproved food additives or additives at unapproved levels: EHS observed bee pollen on the drink menu being added to cocktails as a garnish
violations.corrective_action: Food may not contain unapproved food additives or additives that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 170-180 relating to food additives, generally recognized as safe or prior sanctioned substances that exceed amounts specified in 21 CFR 181-186, substances that exceed amounts specified in 9 CFR Subpart C Section 424.21(b) Food ingredients and sources of radiation, or pesticide residues that exceed provisions specified in 40 CFR 180 Tolerances for pesticides chemicals in food, and exceptions. PIC agreed to no longer add bee pollen to cocktails and removed it entirely from drink menu.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: EHS observed untested being stored in buckets of sanitizer.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed utensils, spoke with EHS about proper utensils storage
